Name: Alchemist Yeoni's Recipe Book
Author: AlchemistYeoni
Description:
Alchemist Yeoni’s Recipe Book
Bring a little apple magic into your kitchen! Collect ornate recipe books, discover 60 apple dishes, and keep your own cooking notes in an illustrated book with animated page turns.

GETTING STARTED
Your collection begins with a letter from Robin about a curious bookshelf.
Purchase the bookshelf from Robin’s Carpenter’s Shop and place it inside your farmhouse. The following day, Yeoni will send you a beginner recipe book as a gift.
Double-click the book in your inventory or toolbar to open it. Reading a recipe page automatically teaches you that dish—then head to your kitchen to cook it!

MAIN FEATURES
• 10 beginner apple recipes and 50 advanced recipes, from sweets and baked goods to drinks and savory dishes.
• Detailed 64×64 food icons.
• A red beginner book and a green advanced book, each with a matching open-book design.
• Animated page turns that carry the illustrations and text along with the paper.
• Personal notes for each recipe, saved automatically.
• A special bookshelf with fixed book positions and room for future collections.
• Hold a recipe book and interact with the bookshelf to store it. Interact without holding a book to choose one to take out.
• Recipe books cannot be sold, shipped, trashed, or dropped.
• Korean and English text. Other game languages use English.

A LITTLE DISCOVERY
Cook all 10 beginner dishes yourself to unlock the advanced recipe book. Watch your mailbox for a hint about where to find it!

BOOK CONTROLS
• Double-click a book: Open it.
• Click the left page: Previous recipe.
• Click the right page: Next recipe.
• Click the notes area: Write a personal note.
• Press Esc: Leave note editing or close the book.

REQUIREMENTS
• Stardew Valley 1.6
• SMAPI
• Content Patcher
• Scale Up Unofficial — required for the high-resolution item icons.

INSTALLATION
[list=1]
[*]Install all required mods.[/*]
[*]Extract the downloaded archive.[/*]
[*]Place both “YeoniRecipeBooks” and “[CP] YeoniRecipeBooks” inside your Mods folder, beside one another.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]Both included folders are required. Keep their folder names unchanged.
